authority.source: UrAi Generic World Library governed modular specification; generic exploration candidate

prompt: Original generic modular ground-shell; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. Road strip 7 m wide through the center, sidewalk bands 1.5 m wide beyond curbs, driveways placed outside reserved pedestrian corridor. Porch shown at sidewalk level by default; any steps need an alternate accessible path. Target bounding dimensions 40m wide x 0.3m high x 32m deep. Materials: asphalt-worn. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
